messages.subject: Re: store dataset on shinyapps.io
parts:
That error seems to be due to the https connection of ShinyApps.io.
Base R does not support directly support https connections, and you
will have to rely on system tools such as wget/curl or RCurl to
download files from https connections. Or if you are under Windows,
you need the setInternet2() function.

In shiny, you can certainly provide certain files for users to
download. Please search for "download" in the gallery for examples:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/

Regards,
Yihui
